tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return,
    AVG(SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax)) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS ctr_state_avg
  FROM catalog_returns, date_dim, customer_address
  WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_year = 2001
    AND cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city,
  ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type,
  ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1, customer_address, customer
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr1.ctr_state_avg * 1.2
  AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
  AND ca_state = 'OH'
  AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
ORDER BY 
  c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name,
  ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city,
  ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type,
  ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

tpch.rewritten_query:
WITH cte_avg_discount AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk, 
        1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM 
        web_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY
        AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
        AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.69 AND 0.84
        AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_item_sk
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM 
    (SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS web_sales
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM item WHERE (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 423 AND 622 OR i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')) AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL) AS item
        ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN '1999-03-22' AND CAST('1999-03-22' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90' DAY AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL) AS date_dim
        ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN cte_avg_discount
        ON item.i_item_sk = cte_avg_discount.ws_item_sk
        AND web_sales.ws_item_sk = cte_avg_discount.ws_item_sk
WHERE 
    ws_ext_discount_amt > cte_avg_discount.avg_discount
ORDER BY SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;
